notes: «أبي» is the compiler's own teacher, not named here: a relation link; the tool adds al-Saduq as the head

the last level holds Abu Bakr al-Hadrami and Kulayb al-Asadi as co-transmitters (rule 2); Kulayb's first mention («و كليب الأسدي فقد رويته») introduces the books, so whether he is a second route or a co-transmitter is not settled (rule 11)
